duplicated_frozen_descriptions.text: Explicit new-authoring selection for selector operator; applies only in selector comparison. Preserve source-effective values and visible overrides; no runtime fallback.
Explicit new-authoring selection for set operator; applies only in present set. Preserve source-effective values and visible overrides; no runtime fallback.
Apply OVAL bitwise AND comparison semantics; do not confuse with Boolean AND across predicates.
Apply OVAL bitwise OR comparison semantics; do not confuse with Boolean OR across predicates.
Compare an observed value with a regular-expression pattern; aligns with OVAL pattern match.
Compare observed and expected values for inequality using native datatype; corresponds to OVAL 'not equal'.
Compare strings for equality without case sensitivity; aligns with OVAL case-insensitive equals.
Compare strings for inequality without case sensitivity; aligns with OVAL case-insensitive not equal.
Compare the observed value to the expected value using its datatype; corresponds to OVAL 'equals'.
Native typed comparison equivalent to OVAL greater than or equal.
Native typed comparison equivalent to OVAL greater than.
Native typed comparison equivalent to OVAL less than or equal.
Native typed comparison equivalent to OVAL less than.

Applies to all descendant fields in every branch of this logical group, unless overridden by a nested group, complete condition or individual field. The nearest explicitly declared requirement wins; omission creates no implicit default. This controls field presence and matching, independently of require.items.
Explicit OVAL-aligned per-field existence and matching requirement inherited only by the fields in this grouped condition; independent from Test Item existence.
Required on arrays, Variable references and Organizational Inputs. Independent of the observed-Item/State/record requirement.
Canonical RFC6901 location in the owning Assessment; semantic validation must resolve it to a requirement node of this Test.
Compare values using the operation's supported datatype and ordering.
Explicit new-authoring selection for traversal kind; applies only in present traversal. Preserve source-effective values and visible overrides; no runtime fallback.

OVAL 5.12.3 fileeffectiverights53_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations, including the source-limited non-equals trustee SID search. filename null selects the higher-level directory. SID identity and effective-rights acquisition remain separate from native string comparison.

OVAL 5.12.3 Windows file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Filesystem lookup remains per-directory/provider case context from the existing mapping; no global case switch is added.

OVAL 5.12.3 regkeyeffectiverights53_object uses the canonical registry-hive enum with equals only; key and trustee_sid retain all five EntityObjectStringType operations. key null selects the higher-level hive. Source-limited non-equals trustee searches and security-descriptor errors remain conversion/runtime concerns.

OVAL 5.12.3 unix file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Existing traversal constraints stay in the capability mapping.
A field predicate or logical combination of predicates applied to one collected Item.
A scalar, ordered list, or explicitly typed value. Use the typed form when the datatype matters; lists preserve their supplied order and duplicates.

Applies to all fields listed under this condition's fields, except fields with an explicit individual field_requirement; sibling conditions are unaffected. The nearest explicitly declared requirement wins; omission creates no implicit default. This controls field presence and matching, independently of require.items.
Canonical RFC6901 pointer into the retained Item to this exact typed record instance, including array index when multivalued.
Combine nested condition results using OVAL-aligned Boolean AND, including non-Boolean evaluation outcomes.
Combine nested condition results using OVAL-aligned Boolean OR, including non-Boolean evaluation outcomes.
Datatype of the supplied literal or record.
Explicit new-authoring selection for assessment logic; applies only in explicit logical group. Preserve source-effective values and visible overrides; no runtime fallback.

For newly authored NG file Objects, editors suggest local and serialize it explicitly (optionally hidden in the editor). This annotation is not a scanner/runtime default. Source conversion must retain the effective OVAL recurse_file_system value: omitted OVAL means all, explicitly local means local, and defined maps to same. Filesystem scope is independent of recursion and applies to full_path as well as directory/name selection.
How many collected Items must satisfy the complete condition (OVAL Test check). Never conflated with items_found.
Logical AND of complete conditions, preserving OVAL six-state outcomes; not an Item or field matching quantifier.
Logical ONE of complete conditions, preserving OVAL six-state outcomes; not an Item or field matching quantifier.
Logical OR of complete conditions, preserving OVAL six-state outcomes; not an Item or field matching quantifier.
Logical XOR of complete conditions, preserving OVAL six-state outcomes; not an Item or field matching quantifier.
Logical XOR: odd number of condition results true under OVAL six-state semantics; distinct from ONE.
Maximum downward hierarchy recursion depth; 0 means starting key only and unlimited maps OVAL -1.
Maximum downward recursion depth: 0 means starting directory only, positive integers bound descendant depth, and unlimited has no depth limit. OVAL -1 imports as unlimited.

OVAL 5.12.3 ntuser_object key and name use EntityObjectStringType with all five string operations. name null selects the higher-level key and empty string remains the default-value name. Existing hive/profile discovery and traversal controls remain separate.
OVAL 5.12.3 systemdunitproperty_object.unit and property are EntityObjectStringType selectors. Preserve all five source string operations; the collected property value remains a state field.
One complete OVAL State-sized condition. All distinct field predicates in this fields mapping are implicitly ANDed; field_requirement never changes this operator.
One complete Test requirement: item_requirement gives explicit existence and satisfaction counts; conditions follow as fields/and/or/one/xor. Field cardinality must be explicit.
One field-key predicate with an explicit include/exclude Set filter action.
Payload for the selected datatype; record data uses an object and scalar datatypes use scalar/list data.
Record data for `record`; scalar or ordered list data for other datatypes.
Required in saved automated Tests. The editor may prefill and hide 'all', but must serialize it explicitly; this is not a scanner default.

Required shared values_found/values_matching pair for comparison Tests. The editor may offer these defaults but must serialize the complete pair. A closer complete pair overrides it; no runtime default.

Resource URI retained for local reference continuity; only the current native wire is accepted. Legacy payloads are preserved under tests/fixtures/v04-native-results/pre-migration-schemas and immutable history, never silently migrated.
Scalar or ordered list data for the selected datatype.
Selected-Item existence requirement (OVAL Test check_existence). Both source all_exist and at_least_one_exists map to one_or_more; preserve their distinct source spellings only in provenance.
The OVAL-style exactly-one aggregation, preserving unknown and error outcomes.

When present, this value requests omission/redaction of the corresponding collected value from emitted result/evidence payloads. The only valid authored value is true; omit the property when redaction is not requested. This directive does not alter collection, comparison, aggregation, or technical truth.
Whether group membership is recursively resolved; importers materialize OVAL default false.

Whether group membership is recursively resolved; importers materialize OVAL default false. The 'resolve_group' behavior defines whether an object set defined by a group SID should be resolved to return a set that contains all the user SIDs that are a member of that group. Note that all child groups should also be resolved any valid domain users that are members of the group should also be included. The intent of this behavior is to end up with a list of all individual users from that system that make up the group once everything has been resolved. New authoring saves this selection explicitly. Source conversion preserves actual/effective values; this is acquisition behavior, not a Test result.
Whether matching groups are included; importers materialize OVAL default true.

Whether matching groups are included; importers materialize OVAL default true. 'include_group' defines whether the group SID should be included in the object when the object is defined by a group SID. For example, the intent of an object defined by a group SID might be to retrieve all the user SIDs that are a member of the group, but not the group SID itself. New authoring saves this selection explicitly. Source conversion preserves actual/effective values; this is acquisition behavior, not a Test result.
